_readme: Don't Tell Comedy cities harvested by scripts/fetch-events.js (source:
'donttellcomedy'). DTC produces secret-location pop-up shows: the city
page at https://www.donttellcomedy.com/cities/{slug}/ server-renders one
card per show with machine-readable hooks:
data-show-date="YYYY-MM-DD"      on each card
data-show-slug="houston-20217"   on each Buy button (one per showtime;
a card can hold two showtimes)
'Buy 7:00 PM Tickets'             button text carries the start time
'Houston - Katy, TX'              area line (venue stays secret until
day-of; neighborhood only)
There is no JSON-LD and no public API — this is attribute-level HTML
parsing, so if DTC redesigns the city page the adapter logs a warning
and the source-collapse guard keeps the last good feed.
Fields per city:
slug        — the /cities/{slug}/ path segment.
label       — prefix used in event names: '{label_prefix}: {Area}'.
venue       — the single venue name all of this city's shows list
under (location is secret; the area goes in the event
name and venue_city instead).
enabled     — per-city kill switch.
Event names always include the showtime ('… (7:00 PM Show)') because
the same area can host an early and a late show on one date, and the
feed's dedupe id hashes name|date|venue.
